purpose.summary: A CGI/web COBOL program that manages the relationship between 'Contas Gerenciais' (Management Accounts) and 'Departamentos' (Departments) in what appears to be a Brazilian financial/accounting system. It supports loading, saving, and deleting account-department associations via an HTML form interface.

EXEC HTML blocks for server-side HTML/JavaScript generation
external-form and identified by clauses for CGI form field binding
Multiple COPY statements for file definitions and working storage
Portuguese-language comments and data names (Brazilian Portuguese)
Session validation and standard header performs (9000-validar-sessao, 8000-cabecalho-padrao)

No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS — uses indexed/relative file I/O instead
verdict.notes: The file uses the Micro Focus htmlpp preprocessor to embed HTML and JavaScript within COBOL source, a pattern common in Brazilian ERP/web COBOL systems. The $set sourceformat"free" directive means the code is free-format despite the mechanical indicator suggesting fixed (the indicator may have been computed without accounting for the directive). The program is clearly production-grade with error handling, session management, and structured section layout. Annotation comments like *>AJ191006:59753 suggest a change-tracking system.
